units.source_zh: “你想想看，斯时你将教竹千代怎样的手段，以对付那老虎？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你想想看，斯时你将教竹千代怎样的手段，以对付那老虎？”

units.source_en: “What should he say?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Gentlemen, many among you passed through the blood and turmoil of this age of war alongside my grandfather and father. You are friends of my grandfather and father.”

units.source_en: “Gentlemen, many among you passed through the blood and turmoil of this age of war alongside my grandfather and father.
units.source_zh: “诸位，你们中多有人与我祖父和父亲同历乱世腥风血雨，一路走过。

units.source_en: You are friends of my grandfather and father.”
units.source_zh: 你们乃是我祖父和父亲的友人啊。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “诸位，你们中多有人与我祖父和父亲同历乱世腥风血雨，一路走过。你们乃是我祖父和父亲的友人啊。”

units.source_en: “Indeed.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Therefore, out of friendship, my grandfather and father would show you a measure of courtesy. But I am different. Do not forget that I was born Shogun.”

units.source_en: “Therefore, out of friendship, my grandfather and father would show you a measure of courtesy. But I am different. Do not forget that I was born Shogun.”

ja.t: からそなたたちにいくらか

units.source_zh: “因此，出于友情，祖父和父亲会对你们客气三分，但我不一样，你们莫忘了，我生来便是征夷大将军。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “因此，出于友情，祖父和父亲会对你们客气三分，但我不一样，你们莫忘了，我生来便是征夷大将军。”

units.source_en: “Oh?”

paragraphs.source_en: “If anyone dares defy me and disturb the peace, I shall show him no mercy. See that you all remember this.”

units.source_en: “If anyone dares defy me and disturb the peace, I shall show him no mercy. See that you all remember this.”
units.source_zh: “若有人胆敢不服，挑衅太平，我决不轻饶，请诸位谨记。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “若有人胆敢不服，挑衅太平，我决不轻饶，请诸位谨记。”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu could not help giving a soft laugh. “Yes. By Takechiyo’s generation, they will all have been born vassals of the Shogun...”

units.source_en: Ieyasu could not help giving a soft laugh. “Yes. By Takechiyo’s generation, they will all have been born vassals of the Shogun...”
units.source_zh: 家康不由一阵轻笑，道：“是啊，到了竹千代那一代，诸人天生便是将军家臣……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康不由一阵轻笑，道：“是啊，到了竹千代那一代，诸人天生便是将军家臣……”

paragraphs.source_en: “By then, there will be no need to start wars, nor any need to slaughter one another. If a dispute arises, a single command from the Shogun will suffice to settle it. Only then will the tiger realize that the sharpness of its claws and the keenness of its fangs have lost all meaning.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “斯时，既无必要发起战事，亦无必要互相杀戮。若有争执，只要将军的一个命令便可解决。只有这样，才能令老虎意识到，爪子之利和牙齿之锋都已失去意义。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good! I asked a foolish question. This must not be disclosed to anyone.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好！我问了一个无趣之问。此事不可泄露出去。”

units.source_en: “I understand.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Go and rest now. I must give careful thought to how I may lend the Shogun a hand.”
